structured_output.notes: Coverage gaps: no Chandapura figure recorded (the portal page was 404 and a search snippet was not verified). No JP Nagar rent or yield was verified, and no Harohalli plot rate was found. No Anekal price figure was found, beyond the Puravankara land deal and the Cauvery water tender. Several established papers (Deccan Herald, Business Standard, Hindu, TOI, ET, Moneycontrol, NIE) were blocked or returned nothing, so many claims rest on PropNewz, a property blog with conflicting page dates, and on developer/broker pages; treat those as low reliability. JLL's 10-15% Yellow Line figure is a forecast, not an outcome. PropNewz's 8-19% appreciation and 60-80k ridership figures are uncorroborated. Hosur airport and Hosur–Bommasandra metro are both at the proposal stage. Excerpts were taken from page-extraction output rather than raw HTML. I could not extract the ANAROCK Q2 2026 PDF text. The Knight Frank H1 2026 South Bengaluru shares (36% of launches, 34% of sales) came only from search snippets of reprints, so I did not record them as claims.
